how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-un-goro-crater-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:4492:details:0: You've got to help me, ⟦1⟧! My friend, Ringo left earlier to explore the volcano to the south of here, and he has been gone way too long. I am really worried about him.
rows.quest:4492:details:1: BDo you think you could find him? Why don't you take my canteen with you -- if you do find Ringo, I'm sure he'll need it!
rows.quest:4492:completion:0: Oh... I'm so glad someone found me...
rows.quest:4501:obj:0: Kill 10 Pterrordax and 15 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to ⟦E2⟧ Frock at Marshal's Refuge.
rows.quest:4501:details:0: Wanted: A skilled fighter to deal with the threat of the Pterrordax that inhabit the ⟦E3⟧. Their numbers are growing, and they are becoming a menace to travelers in the area.
rows.quest:4501:details:1: BDecrease the population by slaying 10 pterrordax and 15 frenzied pterrordax.
rows.quest:4501:details:2: BSpeak with ⟦E2⟧ Frock after completing the task for a reward.
rows.quest:4501:completion:0: I am absolutely terrified of the pterrordax here! Thank you for decreasing their numbers, ⟦2⟧. Now I might feel safe enough to venture out of Marshal's Refuge.
rows.quest:4502:obj:0: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in ⟦E3⟧, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.
rows.quest:4502:details:0: Being an apprentice to Marvon Rivetseeker, I've learned so much. But he's been gone for such a long time now, so I think I'm going to work on some experiments of my own.
rows.quest:4502:details:1: BI've been reading about ⟦E3⟧ most recently, and about the strange volcanic activity going on in the middle of the crater. I think a lot could be learned if I could just get some of the ash from the elementals there.
rows.quest:4502:details:2: BDo you think you'd mind collecting some for me, if you are going that way?
rows.quest:4502:completion:0: These samples will be perfect for my studies! Thank you, ⟦3⟧! I promise, you'll be the first one I will tell about my findings.
rows.quest:4503:obj:0: Collect 8 Webbed Diemetradon Scales and 8 Webbed Pterrordax Scales for Shizzle in Marshal's Refuge.
rows.quest:4503:details:1: BI got stranded here, and I'm absolutely horrible at finding my way around. I'd take a gryphon or wind rider back to Gadgetzan, but those beasts just scare me to death.
rows.quest:4503:details:2: BSo, will you help me? All I have left to build is the wings, and I was thinking that the webby scales from the pterrordax and diemetradon would be perfect. There's no way I'm going to go up against one of those, but you look pretty tough. Why don't you give it a try?
rows.quest:4503:completion:0: Yes, these scales are perfect. I should be able to get this flyer off the ground with these scales for sure!
